title: Coin Change (Number of Ways)
summary: Count the different combinations of coins that make an amount. Coins are handled one at a time, so the same coins in another order are not counted twice.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Coin values
inputs.note: Different whole numbers from 1 to 99; each coin can be used any number of times.
